production_sampling: Latest six distinct report dates on or before 2026-10-02 with verified deployed Markdown and digest-verified frozen evidence; order topics by SHA256(protocol_id + report_date + section + position), take first six per date. Exclude rather than replace unverifiable evidence silently. If fewer dates exist, include all verified dates and disclose shortfall.
publication_verification: Match current public history Markdown to selected final Markdown; bind public workflow identity and successful deployment step where available. Legacy reports without provable identity are excluded from production sample.
repairs: All accessible verified original/repaired pairs up to six pairs, ordered by original run path; blind and independently shuffle both sides. Separate diagnostic examples from published production.
selection: Two complete frozen corpora from included dates, newest first; if inaccessible use two existing frozen diagnostic corpora and label the cohort separately.
reviewers: Fresh gpt-6.1-sol subagents with high reasoning; machine review independent of generation/repair, not human review. No additional paid API calls.
blindness: Packets omit model/provider, prior scores, implementation decisions, paths identifying original/repair, and correspondence until labels are frozen.
double_review: Second reviewer independently labels first twelve SHA256-ordered production topics (or one third rounded up if fewer than 36); all repair pairs double reviewed. Report exact denominators.

rubric.support: Every material claim supported by supplied frozen excerpt evidence; identify unsupported, strengthened, or reversed claims.
rubric.citations: Each cited evidence item relevant; identify unsafe grouping.
rubric.quality: Clarity, completeness, usefulness, each 1 poor to 5 strong with rationale.
rubric.selection: Relevant included topics and important omitted corpus items with evidence references.

disagreements: Retain both labels; fresh third reviewer resolves material grounding/citation disagreements using only blinded evidence and rationales. Report raw agreement and adjudicated outcomes separately.
privacy: Commit protocol, aggregate counts, artifact SHA256 and review identity metadata only. Private excerpts, prompts, judgments and packets stay ignored. Only reproducible synthetic examples can be public.
limits: Excerpt support is not full-article fact checking. Same-model reviewers share blind spots. Repeated cases are not independent deployment observations. Missing private diagnostics limits production claims.

access_amendment_before_assessment.reason: Private historical archive passphrase unavailable. User requested a seven-day fetch split into seven corpora for testing.
access_amendment_before_assessment.cohort: Retrospective reconstructed feed corpora; not exact evidence used for historical production and not a published-artifact reliability sample.
access_amendment_before_assessment.sampling: Fetch trailing seven complete UTC days ending 2026-10-02T00:00:00Z; assign dated items to their UTC calendar day. Retain provenance and health. Use current production config, six sampled topics per nonempty daily candidate up to 36. Generation requires approved no-extra-API subagents; label execution configuration differences.
access_amendment_before_assessment.review: Fresh gpt-6.1-sol agents separate from candidate generators and implementers. Preserve original target and disclose verified production denominator separately.
